scheme: One VPM UDIM material and one NPM atlas material. Original source Multi/Sub IDs stay unchanged on the retained source; source_material_id FACE attributes preserve provenance on export copies. The id and slot fields below are legacy finish keys, not source face IDs.
colour_authority: Artem 2026-10-22 18:46: preserve maps_truba RGB and layout exactly. Slide 57 is monochrome; no RAL is assigned. Finish keys containing RAL are legacy identifiers only.
note: Diffuse texels are the measured source swatches, not a repaint onto the KPP sRGB sample. No RAL is assigned. nearest_kpp_* and ral_note fields are historical analysis, superseded by colour_authority. size_placeholder 128 is the NPM roughness/metallic plate. size_vpm_stub 256 is the VPM ERM/Normal plate and the solid diffuse/opacity plate. npm_max 2048 caps the NPM railing diffuse and opacity. No NPM normal is written. size_full 4096 is the railing source kept on the VPM Diffuse, alpha included. NPM opacity is a separate 24-bit map.

Paint_Red.ral_note: Slide 58 names no red. KPP1 has no red RAL. Nearest KPP sample is RAL 7004 at distance 127.79, which is not a red paint, so it is not adopted. Source RGB is kept. Red is the chimney paint.

Band_RAL5015.ral_note: No truba callout in the pptx. Nearest KPP blue is Cassette_RAL5015 / Metal_RAL5015 (34, 113, 179). Slide 58 lists RAL 5015 in the site palette. Source RGB is kept, not repainted.

Band_RAL7047.ral_note: Source RGB equals the KPP1 Cassette_RAL7047 sample. Slide 58 lists RAL 7047 in the site palette but does not bind it to this swatch. Not a truba callout.

Band_RAL7004.ral_note: No truba callout. Nearest KPP sample is Plinth_RAL7004 / Door_RAL7004 (150, 153, 146), closer than Cassette_RAL7047 (distance 60.62). Slide 58 lists RAL 7004. Source RGB is kept.

Band_RAL7004_Dark.ral_note: No truba callout. Same RAL as Band_RAL7004, nearer to the darker KPP metal sample Grille_RAL7004 (120, 122, 117) than to the plinth sample (distance 37.85). Distinct UDIM so the two greys stay separate. Source RGB is kept.

Railing_Steel.ral_note: Steel cutout, not a flat swatch. KPP1 Railing_Alpha has no RAL (body rgb 125, 127, 130, metal 1, handrail RAL 1021 is a different finish). No RAL is adopted. NPM copies RGB into diffuse and replicates alpha into a separate opacity map, both capped at 2048. VPM Diffuse keeps the source RGBA alpha. Texels are copied, not recoloured.
